description: Optional long-tail structural alignment of primary-advantage: migrate 33 API routes onto createTenantDB and assertCan, add error.tsx boundaries, and close remaining i18n and a11y gaps.

Exception: schools/ranking POST (x-access-key, no user context). FR-2: 3 of 4 converted with justifications. FR-3/4/5/6 done; FR-6 took the DELETE branch with owner note.
